artifactRole: Selected independent acceptance evidence from isolated temporary projects and their original managed Chrome pages

reports.method: Hold a real missing-PNG capture-result response through Page.route, complete version 2 with the production provider, then release the old response and inspect UI and service status.
reports.observed: Version 2 remains committed and complete; Send remains enabled before and after the version 1 error.

reports.method: Delay the original host upload API return until the real UI observes the service commit; inspect controller.read before letting the original provider finish its checks.
reports.observed: Controller frame remains readable when UI is complete and the job is active; the original provider returns complete after one attempt.

reports.method: Real managed-Page reference, native screenshot, recapture, original iframe identity, native touch and layout checks; browser composition and ClipboardEvent input checks.
reports.observed: One-use references, original-page capture, unavailable-image recovery, current opaque background visibility, preserved live form state, narrow themes and editing behavior.
reports.precision: The other owned Page was brought to front, while Playwright focus emulation kept the captured document visible; this report does not claim document.hidden coverage.

reports.method: Independent native Chrome DPR2 capture through the production provider; inspect the saved viewport, crop, mapping and PNG dimensions.
reports.observed: A 1200x695 CSS viewport with DPR2 and 192x192 CSS crop produces the recorded 384x384 PNG with scaleX and scaleY equal to 2.

reports.method: Native keyboard audio timeline and annotation range controls select 0.1-0.3s, then edit only the end to 0.4s and complete both through the original managed Page provider.
reports.observed: Original playback head stays at 4s; capture version advances from 1 to 2; each scene image is separate and no video-frame asset is assigned.
reports.precision: Chosen times commit at 0.01s resolution; playbackTime is the original browser media property near native screenshot.
